info.text:
That call from your crying grandkid? It might be an AI clone.

McAfee: 3 seconds of audio can make an 85% voice match. 1 in 4 adults faced an AI voice scam or knew someone who had; 77% of victims lost money (2023).
FTC: imposter scams cost a reported $3.5 billion in 2025.
FBI: agree on a secret family code word. No code word? Hang up and call back.

Sources: McAfee (2023), FTC (2026), FBI PSA (Dec 2024).
News and education, not financial advice.
